rules.source: app-generated; this file is the approved spot-check sample (Svetlana, 2026-10-23), not a fixed list
rules.words: review words of sections 1-5 plus the challenge-extra words of data/dictionary/block-1.json; a word repeated across sections (RAINFOREST, SHIPWRECK, КОРАБЛЕКРУШЕНИЕ) is used once
rules.places: about half the letters on objects of the word's own section (a third for words of 15+ letters), the rest from the other sections of the block; about 30% of places named by an approved record
rules.neverTogether: Suez with Bosporus/Dardanelles; Hormuz with Gulf of Oman; Drake with Magellan; Antarctica with Southern Ocean; for 15+ letters also Ganges with Indus and Yangtze with Huang He
rules.rivers: a river is either on or at the mouth; 15+ letters: on only (mouths are fixed points)
rules.seas: circle at the centre of the sea (label point, or a deep point within 1.5%)
rules.nesting: no letter inside another object of the same puzzle
rules.spacing: circles at least 5.4% of map width apart; needsZoom true for every puzzle
rules.clues: answer never inside a clue; reveal order as validate-geowords.mjs
